provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one-frame placeholder player character for a side-view 2D exploration platformer; scale reference for a collision envelope exactly one 32-pixel tile wide by two 32-pixel tiles tall.
Primary request: Generate exactly one isolated small anthropomorphic mouse explorer in a neutral, grounded idle pose, strict side profile facing right.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha; absolutely no depicted environment.
Subject: one upright mouse explorer only. Pointed right-facing snout, two large round ears, compact body, simple short travel tunic. Pale gray-blue fur, muted lavender cloth, restrained cool highlights suitable for readability against a dark navy Catacombs environment.
Style/medium: production-quality 16-bit pixel art sprite aesthetic, chunky deliberate pixel clusters, crisp hard pixel edges, dark outline, no smoothing and no antialiasing.
Composition/framing: portrait 1:2 canvas. Center the complete character and show it fully without cropping. Feet touch the bottom anchor and ears reach near the top. Create a narrow, nearly full-height silhouette. Core body approximately twice as tall as it is wide. Head, torso, arms, and legs stay centered inside a single one-tile-wide vertical body column. The visible character should read as fitting a 32-by-64-pixel collision envelope, with no broad horizontal protrusions. Leave only minimal transparent clearance around the complete sprite.
Pose/details: neutral grounded idle stance; arms relaxed close to torso; legs and feet compact beneath body. Thin tail tucked closely behind legs and torso in a mostly vertical S-curve, never extending sideways enough to broaden the bounding box. Small scarf snug around shoulders with no long or windblown end.
Constraints: exactly one character; exactly one frame; one PNG; strict right-facing side view; bipedal upright pose; complete subject visible; isolated transparent-background cutout; narrow collision-friendly silhouette.
Avoid: sprite sheet, animation strip, extra frames, extra characters, scenery, floor, ground plane, cast shadow, ambient shadow, text, UI, border, frame, watermark, weapons, backpack, armor, held objects, action pose, wide pose, outstretched limbs, horizontally extended tail, broad accessories, oversized equipment, quadrupedal pose, front view, three-quarter view, photorealism, painterly rendering, blur, smoothing, antialiasing.
